text:
lee: heads up - noticed a weird surge in websocket reconnects in us-west right after we enabled aggressive idle-timeout on the proxy. reconnects ~2.5x for 12m. some clients didn't resume.
tanya: saw that too. resume failures are mostly "token-rotated" errors. looks like token rotation job ran 1s after we rotated route table.
lee: timeline: route roll -> proxy idle-timeout lowered 10s -> token-rotator cron fired -> clients hit timeout while holding old token -> resume rejected.
rik: is this because resume tokens are single-use and tied to proxy instance id? we changed the instance id namespace with the new routing model.
joel: yes, token includes proxy-gen and issuance time. rotation logic assumed ordered operations but rollout applied in parallel.
lee: sample log snippet: ```text
2026-04-02T04:12:05Z ERROR resume rejected token=rt:usw:gen42 cause=token_gen_mismatch
2026-04-02T04:12:06Z INFO ws close client=10.0.0.9 reason=idle-timeout
```
tanya: quick mitigation: extend idle-timeout to previous value for the region and pause token-rotator for 60s. low-risk and buys time.
rik: agree. also add a tolerance window where resume validates token if rotation happened within last N seconds. helps concurrent rollouts.
lee: can we add a counter metric stream.resume.tolerated_window so we know if it's being hit?
joel: yes, add metric + trace tag so console can surface; helpful for future rollouts.
alerts-bot: alert suppressed: reconnect-spike-us-west resolved (mitigation applied)
deploy-bot: rollback completed: proxy-config v5 -> 2026-04-02T04:14:20Z
lee: followup: propose change to rollout UI to show correlated risks when toggling low idle-timeout + token rotation. currently UI only shows config diffs not behavioral risk.
tanya: product ask: can the console compute an estimated "resume-risk" score based on changes? we can use heuristics: if token-rotation && instance-namespace-change && <idle-timeout delta> then risk = high.
rik: ops ask: emit event stream.rollout.risk(resume_risk=HIGH) so oncall sees it pre-deploy.
lee: billing note: some sessions were billed as new session open; file sent to billing-bot. @billing-bot can adjust if needed.
billing-bot: created BILL-221: provisional credits for affected tenants. tagging support.
joel: long-term plan: decouple resume token validity from instance id; introduce a short grace acceptance of previous namespace and instrument acceptance rate. also add canary gating rule: if resume_tolerance metric spikes during canary, auto-pause rollout.
tanya: also add a preflight check in CI that simulates route-gen + token-rotation + idle-timeout change to catch this pattern.
lee: ok will draft RFC and open tickets: INFRA-840 (token-grace), CONSOLE-412 (resume-risk UI), SRE-2200 (canary auto-pause).
